scripts.build: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && electron-vite build && node scripts/build-sqlite-worker.mjs out/worker
scripts.test:files: pnpm build && pnpm exec playwright test tests/desktop/sql-files.spec.ts tests/desktop/sql-reload.spec.ts
scripts.test:layout: pnpm build && pnpm exec playwright test tests/desktop/layout.spec.ts
scripts.test:keyboard: pnpm build && pnpm exec playwright test tests/desktop/accessibility.spec.ts
scripts.test:design: pnpm build && pnpm exec playwright test tests/desktop/design-polish.spec.ts
scripts.test:screen-reader: pnpm build && pnpm exec playwright test tests/desktop/screen-reader.spec.ts
scripts.test:export-safety: pnpm build && pnpm exec playwright test tests/desktop/export-faults.spec.ts tests/desktop/generated-files.spec.ts
scripts.test:workspace-safety: pnpm build && pnpm exec playwright test tests/desktop/workspace-recovery.spec.ts tests/desktop/workspace-disk-full.spec.ts tests/desktop/workspace-registry.spec.ts
scripts.test:host-recovery: pnpm build && pnpm exec playwright test tests/desktop/host-recovery.spec.ts
scripts.test:capacity: pnpm build && pnpm exec playwright test tests/desktop/workspace-capacity.spec.ts
scripts.test:catalog-scale: pnpm build && pnpm exec vitest run tests/integration/large-catalog.test.ts && pnpm exec playwright test tests/desktop/large-catalog.spec.ts
scripts.test:server-catalog-scale: pnpm build && node scripts/test-drivers.mjs --driver postgres,mysql,mariadb,sqlserver --integration-filter "large server catalogs|rich catalog|Azure catalog" --desktop --desktop-filter "large server catalog|catalog (postgres|mysql|mariadb|sqlserver|azure-sql):"
scripts.test:oracle-catalog-scale: pnpm build && node scripts/test-drivers.mjs --driver oracle --integration-filter "large server catalogs|rich catalog" --desktop --desktop-filter "large server catalog oracle:|catalog oracle:"
scripts.test:clipboard: pnpm build && pnpm exec playwright test tests/desktop/clipboard.spec.ts
scripts.test:soak: pnpm build && pnpm exec playwright test tests/desktop/soak.spec.ts tests/desktop/editor-retention.spec.ts
scripts.test:credentials: pnpm build && pnpm exec playwright test tests/desktop/credentials.spec.ts
scripts.test:backup: pnpm build && pnpm exec playwright test tests/desktop/backup.spec.ts
